description: This file defines an abstract class 'DittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter' that extends logging capabilities with additional features such as setting correlation IDs and MDC entries for Akka-based logging within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods for managing correlation IDs, MDC entries, and logging with multiple arguments.

classes.name: DittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class extending logging capabilities with correlation ID and MDC management for Akka logging in Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets the correlation ID for the next log operation, either from a CharSequence or from DittoHeaders.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets the correlation ID for all subsequent log operations until discarded, either from a CharSequence or from DittoHeaders.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the correlation ID from the MDC for subsequent log operations.

methods.name: setMdcEntry
methods.description: Sets a specific MDC entry by key and value.

methods.name: setMdcEntries
methods.description: Sets multiple MDC entries by keys and values.

methods.name: discardMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry by key.
